TSLS: It was the habit of the gods to kill the rhinoceros, and make a feast of the burnt offering.
It was the habit of the gods to kill rhinoceros and perform sacred feasts after burnt offerings.
HQ2R: Those who renounce meat, and hold their noses when sitting near it, devour men at night.
They, who abandon meat and hold their nose when sitting near it, devour men at night.
NW4M: They practice hypocrisy, and make a show before other people, but they do not understand anything about meditation or spiritual wisdom.
They practice hypocrisy and make a show of it to men but they know not God's gnosis and meditation.

Nanak what can be said to the blind man? He can reply not and nor understands he what is said to him.
T7MF: They alone are blind, who act blindly. They have no eyes in their hearts.
He alone is blind, who does blind deeds. He has no mental eyes.
97P1: They are produced from the blood of their mothers and fathers, but they do not eat fish or meat.
They are produced from the blood of their mother and father, yet they eat not fish and flesh.

8RAT: But when men and women meet in the night, they come together in the flesh.
When man and woman meet at night, there they co-habit with flesh.
QZS2: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.
From flesh we are conceived, from flesh we are born and we are the vessels of flesh.
MX1T: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.
O Pandit, You know not divine knowledge and Lord's meditation and still you call yourself wise.
2XU3: O master, you believe that flesh on the outside is bad, but the flesh of those in your own home is good.
O Lord, you deem the flesh of without bad and the flesh of your home good.
CLH2: All beings and creatures are flesh; the soul has taken up its home in the flesh.
All creatures have sprung from flesh and the soul has taken its abode in flesh.
CVBE: They eat the uneatable; they reject and abandon what they could eat. They have a teacher who is blind.
They, whose teacher is blind, eat what is uneatable and abandon and reject what is eatable.
9TTL: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.
In flesh we are conceived, from flesh we are born and we are the vessel of flesh.
CQDE: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.
O Brahman, you know not Divine knowledge and the Lord's mediation and yet you call yourself clever.

Flesh is allowed in the Puranas, flesh is allowed in the Muslim religious books and flesh has been used in the four ages.
F7L3: It is featured in sacred feasts and marriage festivities; meat is used in them.
Flesh adorns sacred feasts and marriage functions, with them flesh is associated.
H1WY: Women, men, kings and emperors originate from meat.
Women, men, kings and emperors spring from flesh.
J3YA: If you see them going to hell, then do not accept charitable gifts from them.
If you see them going to hell, then you should not accept their gifts in charity,
VUEC: The giver goes to hell, while the receiver goes to heaven - look at this injustice.
See you this injustice, that the giver goes to hell and the receiver to heaven.
SY80: You do not understand your own self, but you preach to other people. O Pandit, you are very wise indeed.
O Pandit, you understand not yourself, but you instruct people. You are indeed very wise.
PAZ4: O Pandit, you do not know where meat originated.
O Brahman you know not, whence flesh has sprung.
X383: Corn, sugar cane and cotton are produced from water. The three worlds came from water.
From water are produced corn, sugarcane and cotton and from water the three worlds are accounted to have sprung.
DZZC: Water says, "I am good in many ways." But water takes many forms.
Says the water, "I am good in many ways". Many are the modifications of water.
TVXC: Forsaking these delicacies, one becomes a true Sannyaasee, a detached hermit. Nanak reflects and speaks. ||2||
Abandoning all these relishes, one becomes a real solitarian Says Nanak deliberately.
1ZJL: What can I say with only one tongue? I cannot find your limits.
What can I say with one tongue? Your limit no one has found, O Lord.
6R51: Those who contemplate the True Word of the Shabad are absorbed into You, O Lord.
They, who reflect on the True Name, merge in You.
FLWL: Some wander around in saffron robes, but without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord.
Some there are, who wander about wearing ochre robes, but without the True Guru no one ever attains to the Lord.
FDDG: They wander in foreign lands and countries until they grow weary, but You hide Yourself within them.
Men have grown weary of wandering in the country and abroad, but You, O Lord, has hid.

FATX: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, through which the Lord shines forth and reveals Himself.
Guru's word is the jewel, which of itself, shows the Lord by shedding Divine Light.
YL50: Realizing one's own self, following the Guru's Teachings, the mortal is absorbed into Truth.
Recognizing one's ownself, through the Guru's instruction, one merges in the True Lord.
7TMQ: Coming and going, the tricksters and magicians put on their magic show.
The impostor who creates a false show, continues coming and going.

RVWY: But those whose minds are pleased by the True Lord, praise the True One, the Ever-stable Lord. ||25||
They to whose mind the True Lord is pleasing, praise the one ever stable True Lord.

Nanak, the tree of worldly deeds bears the ambrosial fruits and the poisonous fruits and the poisonous fruits.
W3N0: The Creator does all deeds; we eat the fruits as He ordains. ||1||
The Creator alone does all deeds, He whom the Lord pampers certain fruit, that very fruit be eats.
RZSY: O Nanak, burn worldly greatness and glory in the fire.
Nanak, burn you in the fire the glories of the world.*
4A9L: These burnt offerings have caused mortals to forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Not even one of them will go along with you in the end. ||2||
These (accursed) or (burnt) ones have made man forget the Name. Not even one of them goes with him.
MPUE: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.
Adjudging all according to their deeds, the Lord drives them in His will.
TMSM: Justice is in Your Hands, O Lord; You are pleasing to my mind.
O Lord, perfect justice is in Yours hand. You alone are pleasing to my mind.
597U: The mortal is bound and gagged by Death and lead away; no one can rescue him.
Binding man down, death shall drive him on and no one can rescue him.
FXZX: Old age, the tyrant, dances on the mortal's shoulders.
Mounting on the mortal's shoulders, the tyrant old-age dances there.

7GBM: So climb aboard the boat of the True Guru, and the True Lord will rescue you.
Embark you on the ship and fleet of the True Guru and the True Lord shall save you.
4W83: The fire of desire burns like an oven, consuming mortals night and day.
The fire of desire, whish burns like an oven, consumes man night and day.
50XT: Like trapped birds, the mortals peck at the corn; only through the Lord's Command will they find release.
The trapped mortal pecks corn. It is through the Lord's will alone, that he can be released.

685Y: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass; falsehood shall fail in the end. ||26||
Whatever the Creator does, that alone comes to pass and falsehood ultimately fails.
